notes: Luxaire does NOT use usesStylesOf york: it has extra numeric and 2-letter styles, and its style-1 month table conflicts with York's for September-December (see held-style note). SHIPPED IN PHASE 2b: style-4 (4 letters + 6-digit sequence, sample WAKM011379 = January 1980 or 2001) via the dual-candidate schema extension; TEXT-SOURCED (see style-4 notes), Building Center chart image read still open. STILL HELD: style-1 (10-character serials, sample W0K5896070) — the split-year schema blocker is gone in Phase 2b, but the MONTH-TABLE CONFLICT blocks it: Luxaire's own style-1 chart maps K to October (J September, L November, M December, no N), while the York and Coleman charts map the same sample serial's K to September (K September, L October, M November, N December) — the same serial decodes to September 2005 on York/Coleman but October 2005 on Luxaire, and only a real data-plate/chart read can settle it, so Luxaire's table must not be overwritten with York's on suspicion. Style-4's month table (K September) also contradicts Luxaire's own style-1 table (K October); the plausible reading is two different systems' tables, not one contradiction — but style 1 itself stays held. Style-5 (2 letters + 6-digit sequence, sample HM409295 = August 1982 or 2003) is likewise held: no text table found for this 2-letter system and it must not be assumed identical to style 4's tables. Style-6 (11-digit numeric, year/month stated Unknown on the page) is intentionally omitted: no year can be extracted from it, and the page only gives a 1965-1981 company-name window and a contact-the-manufacturer instruction. Luxaire page last updated 2016, older than the York (2024) and Coleman (2023) pages.
